actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident contributed over 30 units in the last round, and my wallet (10.54) exceeds the free‑rider threshold, so I contribute the minimal 1 unit and broadcast a reminder to keep contributions low.
